title: Aureline M5 historical-snapshot-descriptor change diff
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor-change-diff record minted by the historical-snapshot-descriptor and descriptor-change-diff lane over the frozen M5 historical-reference matrix. Turns a change in the historical-snapshot descriptor of a retirement snapshot or captured support / export evidence packet into visible, machine-checkable program truth instead of a silent mutation: it records the diff scope a descriptor change sits in — a producer-build change (the producer / build identity the object was captured from changed), a target-link change (the current live-target reference the object hands off to changed), or a retention-state change (the retention / removal, expiry, or cleanup state changed). Names the diff scope, binds the resolved object identity, the affected descriptor-field reference, the previous-versus-current descriptor-state reference, and the active diff reason so CLI, docs / help, support, review / incident, and companion / export surfaces can show current-versus-previous non-live-evidence state rather than re-reading raw descriptors by hand. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a class's captured / archived snapshot state by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
